quotations.old_english: Gif hwylcum men sý ðæs feórþan dæges fefer getænge
quotations.english: if to any man there be a quartan fever incident

source_text: ge-tænge; adj. Incident; incidens :-- Gif hwylcum men sý ðæs feórþan dæges fefer getænge if to any man there be a quartan fever incident, Herb. 2, 12; Lchdm. i. 84, 5, MS. B. v. ge-tenge.
